release_notes: Indoor dual-lens pan/tilt camera (2026) — the indoor counterpart of the indoor/outdoor C246D and the outdoor C545D. Sensor, both focal lengths, wide-angle aperture and full wide-angle FOV triplet, dual 2304x1296 resolution, 10.8x digital zoom, and 512 GB microSD from the official Tapo product page specification table as republished verbatim by distributors. Night vision stated officially as 40 ft (approx. 12 m), IR black-and-white. Telephoto aperture, telephoto FOV, frame rate, dimensions, weight, and operating temperature omitted: not recovered from an official source.

frigate.notes: Mains-powered Tapo cameras expose RTSP once a Camera Account is created in the Tapo app (Settings > Advanced > Camera Account). Dual-lens models: /stream1 and /stream2 map to the two lenses rather than main/sub — confirm per-lens mapping in your setup. go2rtc alternative: TP-Link's proprietary protocol via go2rtc (tapo://<tapo-account-password>@{ip}) is often more stable than RTSP (fewer timeouts / non-monotonic-timestamp errors). The password form is firmware-dependent: either your Tapo app/cloud account password, or user `admin` + the UPPERCASE SHA-256 of the camera password (`tapo://admin:<UPPERCASE-SHA256>@{ip}`) — see go2rtc's Tapo docs. It is not the camera's plain RTSP/Device password. If non-monotonic-timestamp errors persist, disable audio for that camera in Frigate. Chrome may render the go2rtc live view with a squashed aspect ratio (a browser live-view quirk, not the stream); Firefox is correct. The go2rtc tapo:// source also carries a two-way-audio backchannel, so Frigate's live view gets a talk button (mic+speaker). Pan/tilt: Tapo exposes ONVIF PTZ on port 2020 (not 80) — point Frigate's onvif block at host:<ip> port:2020 with the camera Account credentials for manual pan/tilt. (Frigate autotracking stays off: Tapo only does continuous-move ONVIF, no reliable absolute/FOV positioning.)

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile. RTSP streams: /stream1, /stream2. Must enable ONVIF/Camera Account in the Tapo app.
